chunks: One of our companions said to Abu Abdillah عليه السلام: “I feel some discomfort regarding mut'ah, so I have sworn that I will never contract a temporary marriage ever.”
So Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said to him: “Indeed, if you do not obey Allah, then you have disobeyed Him.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, the title of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أَصْحَابِنَا: our companions; members of the Shi'i community transmitting the report
key_terms.الْمُتْعَةِ: temporary marriage; a lawful form of marriage in this context
key_terms.تُطِعِ اللَّهَ: obey Allah; comply with what Allah has permitted or commanded
key_terms.عَصَيْتَهُ: you have disobeyed Him; acted in opposition to Allah

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about swearing to avoid mut'ah permanently?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a man's aversion to mut'ah and his oath to avoid it permanently. Imam Abu Abdillah عليه السلام teaches that refusing a lawful act out of misplaced aversion, in a way that opposes Allah’s permission, becomes disobedience to Allah.
